📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter the value x, mean μ and standard deviation σ.
  2. Press Calculate.
  3. Read the z-score, percentile and plain-English interpretation.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
What does z = 2 mean?
The value sits 2 standard deviations above the mean — roughly the 97.7th percentile.
How is the percentile computed?
With the standard normal CDF Φ(z) via the Abramowitz–Stegun approximation (accurate to ~1e-7).
Can z-scores be negative?
Yes — negative simply means below the mean, e.g. z = −1 is the 15.9th percentile.
